description: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three distinct conditions. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Three lines are depicted: the blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate", starting at approximately 0.1 at layer 0 and increasing to around 4.4 at layer 23, with a notable rise from layer 18 onwards, reaching 1.1 at layer 19 and 2.6 at layer 22; the orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate", remaining relatively stable near 0 across the layers, with values ranging from approximately 0.02 to 0.07; and the green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline", also staying close to 0, with values between approximately 0.02 and 0.06, and showing a slight increase towards the end.
